title: GPT-6 created a pretty decent Idle animation for me
author: maddickingurmom
selftext: Took about 10 minutes and 7 iterations to get GPT-6 to animate this from scratch.

comments.author: unfamily_friendly
comments.body: I think GPT6 is an overkill for this. You might have better result for cheaper, if you film yourself on a phone and use some other AI to extract the animation

replies.author: maddickingurmom
replies.body: I did exactly that and no other model could handle the nuance needed in most cases. GPT-6 seems to be able too, especially when I have it do human anatomy research on how the body balances, make research notes on a local file and then apply said notes to the next iteration.

comments.author: Bratchan
comments.body: fro the animation did you use blender for it to connect to? or does it just make an aniamtion ?

replies.author: maddickingurmom
replies.body: Yep, it uses the bones in blender only. Along with notes and rules it uses to follow a strict audit system.
